<div class="card-body">
'''DS-61-4''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊DS-61-4</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼の操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋3。ブラック4に乗っている場合、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。1フォース消費して自分のリザーブデッキの中から「単独航行」を1枚探しだし、手札に加えることができる。その後デッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの位置に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-DS-61-4-PSA-156625008.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">“暗黒の呪い”の異名を持つ帝国軍パイロット。ラルティアやモン・カラマリなど、反抗勢力に対する幾多の襲撃作戦を生き延びてきた。次の作戦を最後に第一線を退く意向。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' DS-61-4.

'''Card text:'''
A starship he pilots is power +3. If aboard Black 4, he may draw one battle destiny even if not otherwise able. You may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one Lone Pilot and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace.

'''Lore:'''
An Imperial pilot nicknamed “Dark Curse.” He has survived many assault operations against dissident worlds such as Ralltiir and Mon Calamari. He intends to retire from the front after his next mission.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Lone Pilot search does not say continue to draw.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[DS-61-4]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
